about_the_game:
In the game, all organisms are composed of individual cells and external components, allowing you to design multicellular creatures like building blocks, completely driven by your imagination. Can you create the most efficient organism using the least amount of materials?

    A key feature of Cell Craft is its realistic material transport system—you can design and observe the precise trajectory of each particle as it moves between cells. Designing an efficient circulation system will be crucial.

    As in the real world, you’ll encounter predatory organisms, self-sustaining plant-like species, parasitic lifeforms, and more. How will you survive? That’s entirely up to you.

The game features two main modes:

Survival (Nature)

Creative (Laboratory)

    You can also adjust the difficulty level, which affects the types of organisms, resource availability, and environmental factors like light and temperature.

    Note: This game is not a strict educational simulation. Some features prioritize gameplay over scientific accuracy and are intended to entertain and spark interest in the world of cells, not to serve as a scientific reference.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+, Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD 530 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Game features stylized visuals with numerous interactive entities; performance may vary slightly on older systems.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (GTX 1050 / RX 560 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: For smoother experience with large-scale organisms and complex systems, a dedicated GPU is recommended.

short_description: This is a cell survival and construction game. The player initially starts as a perfect hexagonal cell and expands the cell population by collecting and transporting various particles to build themselves. They engage in battles with other organisms and gradually develop into a cellular empire.
supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Korean
